title: Case 046: Expected Transfer Timing — Case 046
initial_request: I’m looking for an update on my property claim for 146 Rowan Walk, Brackenford, ZZ6 1ZZ. Please let me know if there is any information about the settlement or when I might expect payment.
overview: Alder & Vale Insurance’s financial team gave Vera Holt at Blackthorn Risk the approved settlement amount and an expected transfer issue date of 22 August 2025 for Oscar Lee’s claim. Vera recorded the information internally, checked that the timing was indicative rather than guaranteed, and informed Oscar by email. Oscar acknowledged receiving the update; there is no confirmation that funds have arrived.

next_action.summary: Vera should pass the insurer’s confirmed amount and expected issue date of 22 August 2025 to Oscar, making clear that the transfer date is an expectation rather than a guarantee.

outcome: Oscar Lee has been notified of the insurer’s stated settlement amount and expected transfer issue date of 22 August 2025, but receipt of the funds is not confirmed.

events.body: For claim CLM-046 concerning 146 Rowan Walk, Brackenford, ZZ6 1ZZ, the approved settlement amount is £2,840. Our current expectation is that the transfer will be issued on 22 August 2025; this is an expected timeframe, not confirmation that payment has been made.

The insurer’s financial team has provided the approved amount and an expected transfer timeframe. I will clarify that the timeframe is indicative, then relay both details to Oscar without suggesting the funds have arrived.
Thank you for the update on CLM-046. Please confirm that 22 August 2025 is an expected issue date and does not mean the transfer has already been issued.

That is correct: the transfer is currently expected to be issued on 22 August 2025, but the timeframe is not a guaranteed credit date. We are not confirming that the funds have been received by Oscar.

Alder & Vale Insurance’s financial team has advised that the approved settlement amount for your claim is £2,840 and that the transfer is currently expected to be issued on 22 August 2025. They have clarified that this is an expected timeframe, not a guaranteed date of receipt, and have not confirmed that the funds have arrived.
Thanks, I’ve received your update about the £2,840 settlement amount and the insurer’s expected transfer timeframe. I understand that it does not confirm the funds have reached me.
